summary: Enhance your skills with our Inventory Control and Fleet Management Training Course. Learn effective strategies to optimize operations and boost efficiency.
lede: Fleet management training covers vehicle availability, utilization, maintenance planning and the stock controls that support reliable operations. It is designed for inventory controllers, warehouse supervisors, fleet coordinators and operations analysts who need to improve stock availability and fleet readiness. Learners practise setting reorder points and safety stock, reviewing telematics data, prioritizing maintenance and reporting operational costs and performance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate inventory records, warehouse flows, vehicle availability, transport activity, and asset-cost decisions. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need practical control methods rather than advanced programming or engineering specialization.
prerequisites: No formal certification or technical qualification is required. You should have basic exposure to warehouse, procurement, logistics, transport, fleet, or asset-control activities. Working knowledge of spreadsheets is useful, but coding is not required. Advanced digital topics such as Power BI dashboards, GPS telematics analysis, and automated exception alerts are taught at operational application level rather than technical engineering level. A laptop is recommended for worksheet and dashboard exercises.
